title: Guest need (catalog/guest_needs/<key>.json)
description: A need a mod adds to the guests: guest sets give it a range in `preferences` and a limit in `max`, buildings serve it through commodities of `family` (docs/modding/reference/guest-needs.md).

name.description: Text key of the need's name, shown by the guest panel's desire texts.

family.description: Commodity family whose buildings serve the need; one need per family, and not a family of the pack's own desires.
